title: Provider-Compatible Structured Outputs & Genuine Video Recovery
hypotheses: Required scalar claim slots enforce one-or-more explicit model-authored verified claims without relying on minItems; empty optional slots are transport placeholders, never synthesized semantic claims.
Finite numeric enums generated from Pydantic bounds reject out-of-range geometry at schema level without relying on maximum/minimum; preserve meaningful composition granularity.
Fixed four named beat fields prevent absent/short beat arrays without relying on minItems/maxItems.
Host-only cross-field, temporal, mathematical and provenance invariants remain fail-closed.
acceptance: No changes to V3-39 strict_wire_schema or one_shot_structured or consumed workflow.
Candidate schema uses only type, properties, required, additionalProperties=false, enum, items, description; no min/max keywords, pattern or conditional schema.
Numeric finite enums are computed from Pydantic field bounds with deterministic decimals; no manually copied 2.4 or 1 values; total enum budget <=1000.
A model cannot encode empty primary factual claim or height exceeding Pydantic max in schema-valid candidate.
Decoder is transport-only and strict; no generated claims, clamping or semantic rewrite; host Pydantic unchanged.
Offline mock sender and actual synthetic host Manim render with true H264/AAC decoded frame validation and forced NOT_REAL_MODEL gate.
Legacy V3-34..40 tests, frozen V3-33 unseen and V2 Core keep passing.
Document real endpoint provider keyword support as unknown; no model-origin MP4 or pedagogical/production claim.
stop_rules: No authenticated HTTP or inference requests in CI.
No automatic model live-mode enablement on branch.
Never count synthetic video as model output.
